name: Ruhea crater - north-rim window (Bangladesh name, SYNTHETIC)
science_goal: Plan an excursion on the north rim of Ruhea crater: ejecta, rim crest and inner wall

layers.name: Synthetic rim elevation / slope
layers.limitation: Synthetic bowl + rim built from the published diameter. NOT measured terrain. A real global DEM (~200 m/px) is coarser than this demo grid and could not resolve walking-scale hazards.

layers.name: Synthetic surface imagery
layers.limitation: Synthetic colourised terrain. Not an orbital image.

warnings: Real crater name and size (Ruhea, 9.5 km, approved 2016); the 8 km window terrain is SYNTHETIC - no walking-scale NASA data is used here.
No rover has visited this crater: rover photos are MISSING (no substitute is shown).
Coarse-data warning: published global elevation for this area is ~200 m/px, too coarse to judge boulders or small slopes.
Crater centre coordinates are approximate - verify in the USGS Gazetteer before presenting.
